purpose: Retain V145's causal raw-persistence router and unchanged Nash certificate while giving the selected Greedy, FaaSRank, or LoadLeast expert exactly its own frozen native player frontier instead of forcing every expert onto one universal frontier.

first_principles_diagnosis.greedy_native_frontier: Greedy acts on CollectTaskConfig::All and can emit a complete assignment for every common-HPA feasible unscheduled function.
first_principles_diagnosis.faasrank_native_frontier: The frozen FaaSRank baseline calls collect_task_to_sche with CollectTaskConfig::PreAllDone and therefore intentionally emits only parent-complete functions.
first_principles_diagnosis.load_least_native_frontier: LoadLeast acts on the all-unscheduled collection and can emit a complete assignment for every common-HPA feasible unscheduled function.
first_principles_diagnosis.v145_error: A single PreAllDone cohort preserved FaaSRank fidelity but truncated the selected Greedy and LoadLeast command processes.
first_principles_diagnosis.v146_error: A single All cohort preserved Greedy and LoadLeast fidelity but made an unchanged FaaSRank capture structurally incomplete, causing all 27 reference attempts to fail closed before online execution.
first_principles_diagnosis.conclusion: There is no universal player cohort that is simultaneously the unchanged native frontier of all three schedulers. Because the causal state machine chooses the expert before placement, the scientifically faithful unit is the selected expert's own native cohort.

hypotheses.primary: Using the route-selected expert's exact native frontier removes V145's Greedy/LoadLeast truncation and V146's FaaSRank incompleteness while preserving the baseline command process in every route.
hypotheses.secondary: The unchanged complete same-cohort Nash guard can add only certified service-and-welfare improvements to that exact native initializer.
hypotheses.falsification: The sole V147 arm is falsified if it fails any of the same nine strict scenario-by-metric gates on E1526-E1528 or any result-blind native-frontier/dispatch invariant.

allowed_at_runtime: current simulator state, common-HPA placement candidates, containers, queues, node resources, configured bandwidth, and immutable function and DAG configuration
first-seen request identities and causal per-frame arrival counts through the current scheduling window
the frozen V145 rolling-onset plus preceding-80/recent-5 age-55 persistence state machine
the selected expert identity produced by that state machine and the selected expert's frozen native collection rule
one persistent Greedy, FaaSRank, and LoadLeast shadow advanced exactly once per scheduling window on its own native frontier
current admitted immutable work, same-window projected immutable work, cold start, configured parent transfer, and immutable-baseline paper welfare
forbidden_at_runtime: scenario or burst label, registered burst intervals, seed identity, future arrivals, or future state
completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, completed-request aggregates, or outcome feedback
V142-V146 numeric performance values as a runtime lookup, fitted coefficient, seed-conditioned route, or post-reveal route edit
adding a Greedy tail to FaaSRank or otherwise changing any native expert's own emitted player set
information_boundary.adaptive_training_disclosure: V142-V145 training outcomes and V146 reference-integrity evidence were consulted to formulate V147. E1526-E1528 remain an explicitly in-sample adaptive development cohort and cannot support a paper claim.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any history discontinuity, expert lifecycle mismatch, selected native frontier mismatch, incomplete selected assignment, selected-command mismatch, unavailable or nonfinite service/welfare certificate, provenance mismatch, or failed result-blind audit rejects reveal.

route_native_frontier_contract.route_before_collection: Compute the frozen V145 route solely from causal arrival history before selecting the operational cohort.
route_native_frontier_contract.greedy_route: CollectTaskConfig::All; exact duplicate-free feasible Greedy native command order and nodes on the common-HPA feasible all-unscheduled cohort.
route_native_frontier_contract.faasrank_route: CollectTaskConfig::PreAllDone; exact duplicate-free feasible FaaSRank native command order and nodes on the common-HPA feasible parent-complete cohort; do not synthesize or fill a tail.
route_native_frontier_contract.load_least_route: CollectTaskConfig::All; exact duplicate-free feasible LoadLeast native command order and nodes on the common-HPA feasible all-unscheduled cohort.
route_native_frontier_contract.nonselected_lifecycle: Advance every nonselected persistent native expert exactly once on its own native frontier for every scheduling window, but do not require cross-expert cohort equality.
route_native_frontier_contract.dispatch: Dispatch exactly the selected expert's complete native assignment unless the unchanged Nash proposal on that same selected cohort passes the same service-maximum, service-sum, and paper-welfare certificate.
route_native_frontier_contract.nash_acceptance: Proposal complete on the exact selected native cohort; readiness-service maximum nonworse; readiness-service sum strictly lower; immutable-baseline paper welfare nonworse.
route_native_frontier_contract.regression: Tests must prove V145 remains universal parent-complete, V146 remains universal all-unscheduled and invalid for native FaaSRank, V147 uses Greedy=All/FaaSRank=PreAllDone/LoadLeast=All, selected command equality, persistence-state identity, and fail-closed behavior for extra, missing, duplicate, or infeasible selected commands.

treatment.nash_acceptance: same selected native cohort and command count; complete proposal; service maximum nonworse; service sum strictly lower; paper welfare nonworse

training_design.independent_unit: one frozen V142 workload tape and environment seed
training_design.candidate_run_order_rule: Use one seeded permutation of the nine frozen cells; never reorder after a result or failure.

selection_rule.per_scenario_per_metric: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the maximum frozen concurrent V142 baseline mean and candidate-minus-each-baseline is strictly positive on at least two of three paired seeds
selection_rule.zero_completion: retain every run; finite-only QPR is unavailable and zero-completed-as-zero is zero; no imputation or seed replacement
selection_rule.confirmation: A pass authorizes only a separately preregistered untouched E1497-E1516 confirmation cohort; failure retires V147 without seed replacement.

logging_and_blind_audit.per_window: Log V145 persistence state; selected expert; selected native frontier; each expert's source frontier, player count, command count, order hash, and lifecycle; selected cohort hash; exact selected dispatch equality; Nash guard evidence; and existing solver/reference observations.
logging_and_blind_audit.blind_audit: Before reveal validate the exact nine-run product, attempt-1 QC, zero quarantine, ledgers, runtime consensus, frozen pairings/tapes/SLA, nine new references, V145 state identity, route-specific native frontier equality, complete selected assignment, selected dispatch, Nash certificate, and zero parsed candidate performance summaries.
